skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and explain urban economic principles and theories.
Apply urban economic theories to analyze real-world city activities.
Use urban economic theories to propose specific solutions.
Ability to find, read, and synthesize scientific information from various sources.
Effective teamwork skills demonstrated through group project evaluations.
Capacity for independent learning and experience accumulation.
Develop critical thinking skills to solve problems in urban economics.
Study decision-making behavior regarding location choices by households and businesses.
